notes.title: Minor update v1.0.13 - few bugs resolved
notes.content:
Minor update with a bugs resolved:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the achievement for beating the randomizer wasn't triggering
[*] Fixed a bug where the point combo achievement for kicking/hurting enemies wasn't triggering when fighting boss fights. You can now earn this achievement during a boss.
[*] Fixed a bug where the IL speedrun timer wasn't resetting properly after getting over 1 minute (when activating the timer from the options)
[*] Fixed a bug where the Dash would clip in walls in W3 when trying to dash through the yellow rails.
[*] Fixed a bug where if a player would play the randomizer, quit and then try to play a regular world, it would boot the last randomizer seed.
[*] Fixed a few translations issue
[*] Replaced the character sprites and colors to baked sprites instead of shaders and composition. Basically, it is more consistent and wouldn't cause small graphical noise in the pixels of the sprite.
[/list]

Once again, if you find any bugs, [url=https://discord.com/invite/GAv85CuGxJ]let me know on Discord[/url].

Thank you to everyone who reported them!

notes.title: Update v1.0.11 - Fixing more bugs and small improvements
notes.content:
Following the big 1.0.10 updates, I wanted to focus on fixing some smaller (but frustrating bugs) to ease the gameplay a bit more. Here's the list of new things:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved the 2nd player box in the Player Selection screen box to make it more obvious that you can join the game.
[*] Added a level timer (blue) when activating "Speedrun Timer" from the options. It's just visual only, it's not saved anywhere.
[*] Slightly reduced the cooldowns again on the Super Crouch powerup to make it more interesting for speedrunning.
[*] Replaced the big firebar in 2-6 with a smaller one in "Normal" difficulty.
[*] Coded a new falling icicle behavior. After a lot of feedback regarding how frustrating the icicles were, I decided to make them deadly ONLY when they're falling. As an added bonus, just like the icicles standing up, you can walk on them to destroy them for as long as they're blue.
[*] Changed the background of the Parking Lot to purple instead of brown. I personally felt like brown didn't fit the nighttime mood I was going for and I realized it only after launch. Never too late to change it I guess!
[*] Added blocks below the icicles in 3-3 to make it more obvious that you can run under there.
[*] Added snow on top of blocks in a few levels in the Parking Lot to make it more consistent.
[*] Added backgrounds in the escape sequence of W4.
[/list]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed the flashing in the background when the leaderboard is loading. Instead, only the text is flashing. It was resulting in some flickering that could be annoying for the eyes.
[*] Fix a bug with the Ground Pound guy. When killed with a Super Crouch attack, the Ground Pound guys from W1 would still shoot projectiles. Their state is now reset when killed, so nothing unusual should happen.
[*] Fix a visual bug with the firebar appearing behind the pressing machine in W2.
[*] Fix a visual bug with the electric crawler appearing behind the pressing machine in W2 and various other places in the randomizer.
[*] Fix a bug with the Yeti AI. When killed in a ladder, they would fly offscreen when respawning. I fix another bug where the Yeti would continue walking (invisible) after getting killed by an icicle resulting in the Yeti making tiles crumble.
[*] Fix a bug where Sally's hitbox would be offsetted during the Phase 3 resulting in the player being hit despite being far away from the sprite.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.10 with new characters and achievements!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428073/20b9bb3450f9de0915d0715698abfe1f77b70bfe.gif[/img]

After 2 months of post-release updates, this is the last "big" one with new content. Unless there are bugs and/or a sudden increase of players, I will be moving on to my next project. Thank you all for the support since release and I hope that you will enjoy grinding for the new Steam Achievements.
Again, if you have problems with this update and/or you want to report a bug, [url=http://discord.vidvad.games]please join the discord at http://discord.vidvad.games[/url] ! I will announce my new project on the Discord as well in the future weeks! ❤️💙❤️💙❤️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428073/25e0d1c44c92a74e7ccfcec360d8bc952aa51428.png[/img]
[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New title screen animation with an attract-mode (small demo playing when the game is idle on the title screen!)
[*] New UI for the Game Over screen with a countdown like old school arcade games.
[*] 5 new characters that you can play with that needs to be unlocked by earning medals. Also, the ending sequence (dialogue, hud, and cutscenes) will show the selected character instead of George.
[*] New colors for the characters.
[*] Adding 43 Steam Achievements.
[*] Redone the Super Crouch powerup to add a beam when landing and shortening the cooldown when using it.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428073/1010a8e38a2803f7c1e65f66f4d9b5d4f95d2791.gif[/img]
Here's the new Robot skin!

[h2]Co-op bugs fixed in this version[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a bug in co-op where the 2nd player would keep control after the 1st player enters the exit door, causing the game to react weirdly like skipping levels or the game crashing.
[*] Fix an audio bug in co-op where the some of the SFXs for the player was playing one on top of each other resulting in a boost in audio.
[*] Fix a bug in co-op during the escape sequence that would result in the camera not being able to center the 2 players.
[*] Fix a bug in co-op that when a player wins while sliding on the railing, the particles would continue to show. Same happened when the dash particles.
[*] Changed the prompt to join the game in the player select to the "Y (xbox)" button.
[*] Changed the prompt to steal a life, now you can press "A (xbox)" button to rejoin.
[/list]

[h2]Randomizer bugs fixed in this version[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix a bug in randomizer-mode where regular doors would spawn in front of the exit door.
[*] In 4-7 (from the regular game), some enemies would spawn in the void resulting in a instant-kill, which would increase the security meter before the level started.
[*] Continuing after a Game Over wasn't resetting your life count to what was selected in the randomizer configuration.
[*] Wrench Enemy and Static Computer Enemy weren't bouncing if spawned in the upside-down.
[*] There were 7 coins in 4-1 (from the regular game) when it spawned in the randomizer.
[*] Fix a bug where a timeout would softlock the player.
[*] If timing out, the seed would be messed up on reset. So every level, the seed is resetted to the number selected in the configuration to make sure everything is always the same.
[/list]

[h2]Generic bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Renamed the text when a world is locked to "Beat previous world" instead of naming the world to avoid spoilers.
[*] Removed the hitbox of Mrs. Magnet, causing her to hurt the player with her laser only.
[*] Fix a bug where if you take a hit and immediately hide in an opened door during the iframes, the player would be vulnerable.
[*] Fix a few bugs causing the player to be able to dash inside of blocks when dashing into springs.
[/list]

notes.title: Stability Patch - 1.0.9
notes.content:
New update following the addition of the new game modes in v1.0.8, there were a couple of bugs and improvements I wanted to nail down before doing another content update. Here is the list:

[h2]Bugs[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix a potential crash in W4 when dying (game over) in the upside-down area and restarting. The sound would play in loop (player in a constant state of changing gravity) and It would cause the game to crash.
[*] Fix a softlock in the escape sequence of 4-10. When hit by the crusher, it would push you inside of the solid block preventing you from moving.
[*] Fix a bug that would make you invulnerable to spikes and other threats after your iFrames expire (ex; walking on spike). Despite being a fun exploit, that was causing the game to be inconsistent because the iframe would reset if you screen wrap. So I decided to make you vulnerable to anything and reset the hitbox when the iframe expires.
[*]Fix a bug with the Giftbox in World 3 that would make them not shoot ice after respawning from a stun. I also added a frame after the ground pound, so that the giftbox goes back to its original state instead of the squeeze state.
[*] Fix a bug during the W3 boss fight that would make the players celebrate in front of the exit door after it was closed.
[*] Fix a bug with the crumbling block of W3. If it crumbles and you're still touching a solid platform, when it will respawn you will fall through despite the block being there. So now, for as long as you're still touching the crumble block, it will crumble again after a respawn.
[*] Fix a bug with the crumbling block of W3. If it crumbles and you're still touching a solid platform, when it will respawn you will fall through despite the block being there. So now, for as long as you're still touching the crumble block, it will crumble again after a respawn.
[*] Fix a bug that would trigger a blue transition screen in front of the game when dashing into spikes.
[*] Fix a bug that would not spawn any coins in the W2 boss fight during the RANDOMIZER.
[*] Fix a bug that would make upside-down gift boxes not trigger any ice after a ground-pound during the RANDOMIZER.
[*] Fix a bug in the File Select that would make you still able to move your selection even after clicking. The focus is now out once you click.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a car horn SFX when Sally Snowplow spawns at the beginning of the W3 fight (during the warning sequence)
[*] Added multiple SFXs during the Mr. and Mrs. Magnet fight.
[*] Small visual improvement. During the Billy Big Box fight in W1, the phase 3 bullets will appear inside of the box instead of in front of it.
[*] Added an icon on the file select screen for when you beat Arcade-Mode (next to the other 4 worlds)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Note Update 1.0.8[/h1]
Update 1.0.8 brings two new game modes to Goliath Depot: a speedrun practice mode and a randomizer. This update also improves the UI in various screens like the File Select and the World Select to try to make it more consistant.

[h2]Randomizer[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428073/2e6292e0dfda5f8a6466a809810dbe4297e942c0.gif[/img]
[i][b]Disclaimer [/b]that the randomizer mode was made for seasoned players. It is unlocked only when you have completed the game.[/i]

In the randomizer mode, you play a random sequence of levels based on parameters that you will set before generating the sequence. The structure of the level stays the same but dynamic objects (doors, exit, enemies, coins) are shuffled around. It is procedural, so there is a list of predefined positions that is selected randomly based on the seed number. You can decide to turn on or off what you want to randomize from the menu.
This mode is "seed"-based, which means that the randomization algorithm will always be the same if you input the same seed number twice. It's ideal for speedrun races or if you want to retry the same seed.
[list]
[*]Number of levels - 16, 24, 32 or 40. All four bosses will appear evenly no matter the number of levels. For instance, if you select 32, it will appear in level 8, 16, 24 and 32. If you select 16, it will appear in level 4, 8, 12 and 16.
[*]Number of extra lives - from 1 to 10.
[*]Difficulty - normal, hard or progressive. Progressive difficulty will start the game with normal levels and will turn the game to "hard" difficulty in the 2nd half.
[*]Random door placements
[*]Random enemy types and placements
[*]Random coins
[*]Random spikes and icicles
[*]Random security camera-laser - usually in HQ
[/list]
[h2]Speedrun Practice Mode[/h2]
In this mode, you can practice each levels individually. The game will save your best time locally for 5 categories:
[list]
[*]Any% - no restriction, play as fast as you can (solo only)
[*]Any% co-op - no restriction, but with a 2nd player
[*]No Power - play as fast as you can without the use of a power (solo only)
[*]All Coins - no restriction except you need to collect all coins in the level (solo only)
[*]Pacifist - don't kick any enemies (solo only)
[/list]
As an extra challenge, I have played and set a time for each level. These are my personal best times. If you can beat my time in all 40 levels, you will unlock a new color palette for your character!

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428073/c0f1ace10558c0439fba785fea6ec569aedcf98a.gif[/img]
Other than the 2 extra game modes, UI was improved in the File Selection menu, World Selection menu, Difficulty Selection menu, in order to stay consistent from one screen to another. I also added a background for each stages to make it a bit more dynamic!

[h2]Last update?[/h2]
There are a little bit more than I want to do with Goliath Depot for the next update, stay tune because yes, there is going to be an UPDATE 1.0.9 soon. As a small reward for your support, I'm discounting the game for the GAMES FROM QUEBEC special week to try to get new players to challenge the current ones on the leaderboards ;)

Check out my fellow game developers from Quebec this week, there are tons of great games from Quebec being showcased.

Once again, if you notice any problems with this build, let me know on Discord.
Thank you!

notes.title: Major update - Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
This is a big patch and for sure the last of 2023! First, I wish you a happy new year!
This patch fixes many bugs and adds a few new features. There's going to be a version 1.0.8 next week, but after that, the focus is going to be for version 1.1.

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Extra life in Hard Mode is now given at each 100K points instead of 50K to make this difficulty a little harder.
[*] The level number is now displayed during the transition between levels.
[*] The level number and statistics (kills, deaths, points, etc.) are displayed when you pause the game or when you game over. It's now possible to check if you collected all coins, if you're deathless, etc. if you try to tackle the medals.
[/list]
[h2]Bugs and improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would softlock the player on the menu after beating the 1985 Arcade-Mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where mashing the confirm button after starting a game would unselect/select a power during the transition.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that would replay the transition animation if mashing "Restart" after a game over.
[*] Fixed a bug that would result in a blue panel appearing above the gameplay when falling into the spikes.
[*] Fixed a bug that would make the laser sound effects muted if you beat the game twice on the same gaming session. The volume was lowered but not set back to 0.0 for the next passthrough.
[*] Fixed a visual bug in W4 where some exit doors were green.
[*] Removed the "Combo Lost" mention if there is no active door combo. Also, it has been removed when opening the very last door in the escape sequence.
[*] Replaced text for "Out of Time" with "Time's up/Temps écoulé"
[*] Recentered the "Goliath Headquarters" logo. "Goliath" was offsetted to the left.
[*] The Player-2 box in the player select screen is more vivid green than before.
[*] When buying a new power, it now auto-picks it.
[*] Added a black outline around the text showing the controls on the player select screen because the background was very light and it was hard to see.
[*] The Gift Box enemies of W3 are triggered from further away in Hard Mode. It's when they see you at a distance of 120px in Normal Mode and now 168px in Hard Mode.
[*] 2-5 (Hard Mode only) - the battery appearing in the middle of the screen was floating in the air. It now appears on the platform above as intended.
[*] 2-6 - fixed a visual bug if hiding in a door behind the pressing machine
[*] 2-Boss (2-player only) - fixed a bug where the health bar of the boss would be messed up after healing with the enemies.
[*] 2-Boss (Hard Mode only) - added a few more enemies during the Mrs. Magnet phase
[*] 4-7 (Hard Mode only) - fixed a bug where 2 boxes were spawning mid-air and inside of the wall. These two enemies were supposed to be Drones, so it has been replaced by Drones
[*] 4-10 - the doors are now permanently closed after defeating the boss in order to fix an exploit that would result in the player closing all doors in a loop with no threat, and therefore making infinite points due to the combo.
[*] 4-Boss - Improved selection of boss recall. It will not spawn the same boss until all 3 have been spawned once.
[/list]

[h2]Major Improvements[/h2]

[b]Completely re-wrote the AI algorithm for the Yeti and the Security Guard. It affects levels 3-5, 3-9, 4-2, 4-4 and 4-10[/b]

[list]
[*] They can jump down and up 1-tile stairs now, making it possible for them to go anywhere in 3-9 and not be softlocked in an area.
[*] Their speed and jump height is now consistent from level to level (ex; the Yeti in 3-9 were faster than the Yeti in 3-5 which wasn't supposed to be). The Security Guard is also a little bit faster.
[*] Their speed is increased in Hard Mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that would make them run against a wall and stay still forever.
[*] Fixed a bug that would make them staying still after being stunned and respawning.
[/list]

[b]Completely re-wrote the RNG of Sally Snowplow (W3 boss fight)[/b]

[list]
[*] Sally Snowplow will now always appear next to a random opened door. It is easier to predict the RNG and not be frustrated because it won't appear far away from the last opened door.
[*] During the "COIN" room, Sally Snowplow will drive at the bottom of the screen on the 2nd pass.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Mini Snowplow were stuck and not moving after being stunned.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause invisible (despawned) enemies to still be active in the level and therefore being stunnable, resulting in kicking invisible enemies. This would make Pacifist almost impossible.
[/list]

[b]Improved Mr. Goliath fight in Hard Mode (W4 boss fight)[/b]

[list]
[*] Mr. Goliath is a lot faster than in Normal Mode
[*] More bullets and faster bullets during the "HA! HA! HA!" phase
[*] More enemies are spawning when calling 1-800-GOLIATH
[*] Big Box does its ground pound projectile attack when spawning
[*] Mr. Magnet spawns more bullets.
[/list]

tags.balance_change: The Gift Box enemies of W3 are triggered from further away in Hard Mode. It's when they see you at a distance of 120px in Normal Mode and now 168px in Hard Mode.

tags.bug: 2-5 (Hard Mode only) - the battery appearing in the middle of the screen was floating in the air. It now appears on the platform above as intended.
2-6 - fixed a visual bug if hiding in a door behind the pressing machine
2-Boss (2-player only) - fixed a bug where the health bar of the boss would be messed up after healing with the enemies.

tags.feature: 2-Boss (Hard Mode only) - added a few more enemies during the Mrs. Magnet phase

tags.bug: 4-7 (Hard Mode only) - fixed a bug where 2 boxes were spawning mid-air and inside of the wall. These two enemies were supposed to be Drones, so it has been replaced by Drones

4-10 - the doors are now permanently closed after defeating the boss in order to fix an exploit that would result in the player closing all doors in a loop with no threat, and therefore making infinite points due to the combo.

tags.feature: 4-Boss - Improved selection of boss recall. It will not spawn the same boss until all 3 have been spawned once.

tags.bug: They can jump down and up 1-tile stairs now, making it possible for them to go anywhere in 3-9 and not be softlocked in an area.

tags.balance_change: Their speed and jump height is now consistent from level to level (ex; the Yeti in 3-9 were faster than the Yeti in 3-5 which wasn't supposed to be). The Security Guard is also a little bit faster.
Their speed is increased in Hard Mode.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that would make them run against a wall and stay still forever.
Fixed a bug that would make them staying still after being stunned and respawning.
Sally Snowplow will now always appear next to a random opened door. It is easier to predict the RNG and not be frustrated because it won't appear far away from the last opened door.

tags.feature: During the "COIN" room, Sally Snowplow will drive at the bottom of the screen on the 2nd pass.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the Mini Snowplow were stuck and not moving after being stunned.

Fixed a bug that would cause invisible (despawned) enemies to still be active in the level and therefore being stunnable, resulting in kicking invisible enemies. This would make Pacifist almost impossible.

tags.balance_change: Mr. Goliath is a lot faster than in Normal Mode
More bullets and faster bullets during the "HA! HA! HA!" phase

tags.feature: More enemies are spawning when calling 1-800-GOLIATH
Big Box does its ground pound projectile attack when spawning

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5
notes.content:
Another patch with bug fixes noted by the community on the Discord server.

[list]
[*] Fix a bug that made the game start with the wrong amount of lives based on the difficulty selected. It's 3 extra lives for Normal and 2 extra lives for Hard.
[*] Added a prompt in the HUD in co-op when a player is game over to "press X to steal a life". It steals a life from the surviving player.
[*] Various French correction and typos in the translation file
[*] Fix a bug during the last boss fight in co-op where the camera would continue following a player even if it is game over resulting in a softlock because the camera wouldn't follow the remaining player anymore.
[*] Fix a bug during the last boss fight in co-op where if you steal a life from the remaining player, you would respawn offscreen.
[*] Fix a bug in co-op resulting in both player being solid to each other. Now it is possible to walk/run through them.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Another round of bugs and improvements for the first week of the game. It's getting more and more stable but if you find anything game-breaking, let me know on Discord.

[list]
[*] Fix a bug where the difficulty would not load correctly if you select Normal or Hard, it would play the other one. It was due to a bad refresh in the game manager refreshing AFTER loading the world data.
[*] Fix an issue where you could still press back or change leaderboards while it was loading resulting in problems showing the time and score accurately.
[*] Fix a few visual bugs in the recap screen after beating worlds. Arcade-mode was shown as "Warehouse" and it also said 80 coins instead of 340. W4 was saying "X/80" as well instead of 100.
[*] Fix a bug that was resulting in deaths during the restart. There was a window of 1 sec where the player was unpaused and active and they could die, so the player had 1 less life when starting back at the first level.
[*] Fix a bug with the dash. Dashing next to wall can glitch you inside of blocks. Now it checks before dashing and will result in nothing if too close to the wall.
[*] Fix a glitch with the W1 boxes that would be stuck in the air sometimes in 1-8 on Hard difficulty after going on a moving platform.
[*] Fix a bug that could result in the door beam in the cutscene not reaching the last enemy and so the player could die in the cutscene.
[*] Fix a few UI bugs in the World Selection menu with the worlds & powers, preventing the player from accessing content that was supposed to be locked.
[*] Renamed "1985-Mode" to "1985 Arcade-Mode"
[*] Added a background in the W1 boss fight
[/list]

notes.title: Goliath Depot is OUT!
notes.content:
[h2]The Launch[/h2]

[u][b]The last 72 hours were crazy![/b][/u]
From staying awake all night the day before the release to fix bugs and implement the last key features, to releasing the game live on Twitch with more than 50 concurrent viewers supporting the game right away, it has been quite an amazing ride so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428073/d279cf84e3ba47b69e4366b2ebd07c4c676f115f.png[/img]
[url=https://twitch.tv/supermegadav]Follow my Twitch channel here if you want to watch![/url]

[u][b]I'd like to say a HUGE thank you to everyone who took the time to play[/b][/u].
Some of you reported bugs, your cool bragging achievements, new game ideas, and everything has been noted carefully (and some are even already implemented!). Keep in mind that I'm a solo developer, so I can't fix everything right away. I need to prioritize features. I'm still working hard to fix urgent bugs but I think that all game-breaking and major issues were solved withinin the first 48 hours. You can check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2479030/view/3866967347639521755?l=english]Patch Note that I made for V1.0.3[/url]. The best way to report problems if you encounter any, is to post them directly on the [url=http://discord.vidvad.games]official Vidvad's Discord server[/url] in the [b]#bugs-feedbacks [/b]channel.

I'm very proud that we were able to reach 10 positive reviews in less than 24 hours especially for such a niche game that released in the middle of the holiday season (yikes, I know it's not the best time to purchase a game, but the timing wasn't right before!). If you played the game and has not posted a review yet, I recommend doing so to help reach 100 reviews which is the next milestone! These milestones make Steam promote the game more, so it's super important. The game is 15% off until December 25, so now is a good time to purchase and play during the holidays!

Ok, so now that we have the game in a stable condition, what are the next steps exactly?

[h2]Roadmap for the next months[/h2]

[u][b]Goliath Depot took 6.5 months to develop[/b].[/u]
My goal was always to make a small and compact arcade game but the more time I was putting into the development, the more ideas I had. My vision was to launch it with my initial plan of a small game and if it was well received by gamers, I'd develop extra content as a bonus. I didn't want to waste effort on a project that nobody wanted to play. I'm happy to say that so far, the reception has been super positive and I already made a list of important features I'd like to add to the game until February 2024. Then, I will evaluate if it's worth the effort to continue for a few more months, or if I move on to the next project.

If you have feature requests for a V1.1, jump into the Discord server to chat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428073/7478ac6fab3ee438514d8281f92cab918596d6ff.png[/img]

[h3]Features to be added in V1.0 before the end of 2023[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unlockable character skins and color palettes. Everything is already implemented, I need to finish drawing the skins.
[*] New speedrunning features - a practice mode unlocked when you clear the game in which you can select any level and play it. It saves your best time locally. I will also add a IL (Individual Level) timer in the main game when you activate the Speedrun Timer in the options.
[*] An improved transition system between levels with the level number and name to keep track of what you've done, where you're at and what's missing.
[*] Credits (yeah I know, I haven't even did the credits!!!)
[*] Steam Achievements
[/list]
[h3]Features that will be added in a V1.1 in February 2024[/h3]
These are confirmed features. There are more that I'd like to add but I'm committing to at least finish these and if I have time, I will add more. I know that the game can be quite short if you're only doing the bare minimum, but this is what it is! It's obviously inspired by early NES games and 80's arcades which were built to be that way. BUT, I'm listening to feedback and I know people want more! So my goal is to add more content to the game while also staying true to what it is!
[list]
[*] Input rebinding and more controller support.
[*] New game modes to be unlocked after beating the game. Nothing to reveal yet, but there are a few "remixed" game mode that I'd like to push soon for both solo and co-op.
[*] Bonus levels - initially I made secret bonus levels that you could find within the game. Mini-games that would grant points but I scraped the concept a few weeks before release due to a lack of time.
[/list]

[h2]Steam Curators, influencers and YouTubers[/h2]

With the hectic end of development, I haven't have time to do a lot of marketing to influencers. I reached out to a few, but if you're a curator that would like to cover the game, send me a message on Discord. I have been overflown with weird emails, many of which I suspect being scams (sorry if you're not), so to confirm that you're legit, I'd prefer to have a Discord conversation before handing out keys. I don't want to see a key being sold on a bootleg foreign website. This will be a priority for me in the next few weeks.

PS. you don't need to have a million followers for me to hand you a key. I'm also a small streamer with a very small crowd, I know what it's like. I'm mainly looking for retro gamers, speedrunners and co-op enthusiasts. Don't be afraid to reach out! 

[h2] Next project![/h2]

No spoilers (the game is already wishlist-able on Steam anyway) but the next project is going to be [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2182780/Chaos_in_Aisle_Seven/][b]Chaos in Aisle Seven[/b][/url]. Not in the form that was promoted on Steam, I will revise what the page says and how I advertised it to not get into trouble with expectations. The hook stays the same, but the gameplay will be a bit different. Stay in touch, but I'll start working on this very soon!

Happy holidays everyone!
-David (Vidvad)

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who reported bugs on Discord. As a solo dev, keep them coming, I appreciate greatly! If you're not yet on the Discord and want to contribute,[url=https://discord.com/invite/GAv85CuGxJ] you can join here[/url].

[h2]Bugs[/h2]

[list]
[*] Hide the "Insanity" difficulty still shown in leaderboards and on the world select screen because it is not possible to unlock it right now in V1.0.
[*] Corrected a few grammar typos and errors in English and French.
[*] Fix a bug that would play the wrong song or victory jingle after a game over.
[*] Security Guards in the W4 Headquarters are not able to jump on the moving platform at the bottom of the screen and stay stuck.
[*] Fix a bug that would result in the World Unlock animation to play again after quit, restart or game over, and reentering the world select screen.
[*] Fix a bug that wouldn't refresh the total coin after purchasing a power.
[*] Fix a bug with the music being too loud on the world selection screen because it was in the wrong Audio Bus.
[*] Fix a bug that prevented the Pacifist medal to be earned in the W4 Headquarters because it was required to kick to win. So now it's possible.
[*] Fix a bug during the W3 boss fight where you could be stuck in the railing by staying on the 3rd floor
[*] Fix a bug that would destroy doors during the W1/W4 boss fights making it impossible to finish because they wouldn't reopen at the end of the cycle.
[*] Fix a bug that would shuffle the doors during the snowstorm of the W3 boss fight resulting in doors being closed reopening and vice versa.
[*] Fix a visual bug where the Mini Snowplow during the W3 boss fight would be offseted when kicked
[*] Fix a bug in 2-6 where the firebar in the middle was small in HARD difficulty instead of big.
[*] Fix a bug that resulted in the player being able to die in the "How to play" cutscene so they would start with one less life in 1-1.
[*] Fix a bug that would play the wrong song or victory jingle after a game over.
[*] Change the total number of medals to 25 instead of 20 to add the 1985-mode medals to the total
[*] Added the build number in the title screen (bottom right) to help keep track of version
[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] After player feedbacks, doors are now yellow during the W3 and W4 boss fights. It means that they act like in the boss fight of W1 and W2 where you need to close all of them for them to reopen.
[*] In the W3 boss fight, the snowplow has a chance of freezing random doors when the snowstorm hits.
[*] Added a SFX that screams "HURRY UP" when there are less than 20 seconds on the timer.
[*] Re-written descriptions of the power items in French and English and added button-prompt in it.
[/list]

notes.title: New demo for the October Steam Next Fest - play it now!
notes.content:
[h1]New demo![/h1]

Ever since the demo was released in August, I've been receiving tons of positive feedbacks and it's super motivating to keep working on it. Thank you to everyone who played it!
I'm super happy to publish this new update just in time for the Steam Next Fest. Here's what's included since the last update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44428073/24e94fa501e6680ba7b27c9da87ffe2f01b66674.gif[/img]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Online leaderboards for best time and best score.
[*] The demo is fully playable in 12 languages (English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, German, Turkish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese). Big big shoutout to all who helped with the translations!
[*] New UI font to help the readability for all languages.
[*] Tweaks in the design of levels 1-2, 1-3, 1-7 and 1-8: primary goal was to accelerate the gameplay and remove constant waiting and annoying enemies.
[*] New combo system if you kick successive enemies.
[*] A bonus of 1000 points if you finish the level with all coins.
[*] Added a timer in the boss fight to prevent farming infinite points.
[*] Anonymous game session analytics uploaded to the server (you can opt out in the settings if you don't want, but keeping it on for the demo will help greatly).
[*] Improved UI overall.
[*] New world selector with small dioramas.
[*] New song for the title screen.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies will die and respawn if they fall on spikes.
[*] Removed the ability to move during the transition after the player restarts the level.
[*] In 2p co-op, closing a door when someone is hiding now results in the player being bumped out of the door.
[*] In some level, the screen shake was showing artifacts on the side of the screen
[*] When the "ready?" was shown, there were grainy pixels in the background. It's fixed.
[/list]

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

Goliath Depot will be featured in the October Steam Next Fest with a brand new shiny demo. When it's over, the focus will be to finish the game and release it. Speaking of releasing, I'm proud to announce that the game will release on [b]Tuesday December 5, 2023[/b]! Mark your calendar! The game will feature all 6 worlds of the story-mode + an unlockable "randomizer" mode that will act as a NewGame+.

[h3]Randomizer[/h3]
In the randomizer mode, you will need to beat all 60 levels in one sitting with the help of powerups! Powers will range from a speed boost, to a double jump, and even the possibility to shoot projectiles. The catch is that the level order, the door placement, the enemies and much more will be shuffled around in each new run. Think of it like a mini-Roguelike version of the game ;)

---

I hope you are as excited as I am to see this game on Steam !
Thank you very much for your support and enjoy this new version of the demo :)

-David (Vidvad)
